import unreal
comp=unreal.load_object(None,'/Temp/Untitled_1.Untitled_1:PersistentLevel.NiagaraActor_UAID_18C04D87C619FFF102_1453982871.NiagaraComponent0')
rt=unreal.load_object(None,'/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy.RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
if comp is None or rt is None: raise RuntimeError('Component or RT missing')
world=comp.get_world()
raw=unreal.RenderingLibrary.read_render_target_raw(world,rt,True)
color=unreal.RenderingLibrary.read_render_target(world,rt,True) if raw is None else None
if raw is not None:
    rs=[float(c.r) for c in raw]
    mode='raw'
elif color is not None:
    rs=[float(c.r)/255.0 for c in color]
    mode='color'
else:
    raise RuntimeError('RT readback failed in raw and color modes')
nonzero=sum(1 for v in rs if v>0.001)
full=sum(1 for v in rs if v>0.99)
print('RT_STATS=' + repr({'mode':mode,'sampleCount':len(rs),'minR':min(rs) if rs else None,'maxR':max(rs) if rs else None,'meanR':sum(rs)/len(rs) if rs else None,'nonzeroPixels':nonzero,'fullPixels':full}))
